name: North Nicosia (Northern Cyprus)
description: A white field bearing the emblem of the Nicosia Turkish Municipality — a stylised gold ring of the city walls around the year 1958 — beside the words 'Lefkoşa Türk Belediyesi' in black.
history: The Turkish Cypriot municipality of Nicosia was founded in 1958 and has governed the northern half of the city since its division in 1974. The flag bears the municipal emblem and name; no adoption date has been published.

features.role: emblem of the walls and bastions with the date 1958
features.symbolism: the founding year of the municipality
